## Bug Fixes

- **cli-repl**: Keep SIGINT handled during an in-flight interrupt (MONGOSH-3816, #2896)
- **ci**: Pick newest Node.js nightly with a host-arch build (#2901)
- **cli-repl**: Do not double-encode a prompted TLS key password (MONGOSH-3294, #2895)
- **ci**: Use env instead of doing interpolation (MONGOSH-3705, #2892)



See an overview of all solved issues [in Jira](https://jira.mongodb.org/issues/?jql=project%20%3D%20MONGOSH%20AND%20fixVersion%20%3D%202.14.2)
